svg.text: A chain down through five stages — investigating failed pseudoscience, naming the failure 'Cargo Cult Science',
defining the missing integrity, showing self-deception even among honest scientists, then a run of case studies —
ending in a loop back to the opening wish for honesty.

g.text: A funnel from scattered pseudoscience-hunting narrows to one diagnosis (missing integrity), which then fans out into
case studies before looping back to the opening theme.
